item.title: AI Is Looking For You
item.description: An interactive story in nine scenes about how professional discovery is changing: an agent scanning three fictional careers in fifteen seconds, the same person described two ways, the beautiful portfolio that describes nothing, the five signals a machine needs, the digital shadow that arrives before you do, and a search box where you can brief the agent yourself.

item.title: Your AI Is Brilliant. Then the Bill Arrives.
item.description: A plain-English and technical guide to what really drives enterprise Gen AI costs — tokens, context windows, RAG, agent loops — and how to control them without starving your model of the tokens that actually matter.

item.title: AI-Native Software Development: Best Practices for Building Without Breaking the Flow
item.description: AI-assisted development isn't about typing code faster. It's about preserving context, standardizing knowledge, and handing work off cleanly across people, tools, and time zones. A practical framework for building institutional memory around AI — with a reusable skill, a full EOB handoff prompt, and a Context → Plan → Build → Verify → Record → Handoff → Learn loop.

item.title: The Decision Abyss — Part 3: The AI Intermediary
item.description: AI is making purchasing recommendations — but businesses can't see it happen, track it, or verify it. A new opaque layer in the decision stack.

item.title: What Are Claude Skills? — The Basics
item.description: No jargon. No assumptions. A plain-language guide to Claude's Agent Skills with actual files opened up and explained — SKILL.md anatomy, progressive disclosure, and how Skills trigger. Part 1 of 3.

item.title: The Connector Map — How Claude Talks to Your Tools
item.description: Skills taught Claude how to do things. Connectors teach it where to find things — your Drive, inbox, Slack, and calendar. The complete landscape of MCP connectors. Part 3 of 3.

item.title: Skills in Action — Real-Life Walkthroughs
item.description: Four real people. Four real tasks. Step-by-step breakdowns showing exactly which files Claude opens, which code it runs, and what you get at the end. Part 2 of 3.

item.title: Why Most AI Users Are Still Pre-Literate
item.description: You can type a prompt. That doesn't mean you can read. The real skill gap in the AI age isn't access — it's understanding what you're actually holding in your hands.

item.title: The Great Re-Mark of 2028
item.description: Three forces converged. The world re-sorted. This is what it looked like.

item.title: The Post-Query World: When AI Answers Before You Ask
item.description: We spent 50 years teaching humans to ask structured questions. What happens when AI eliminates the need to ask at all? Exploring the end of search as we know it.

item.title: You Can Teach Claude. Here's How.
item.description: Most people use Claude like a vending machine. Enterprise builders need something more. Enter Skills — the mechanism that turns Claude into an AI operator that actually knows your world.
